title: Soon and Very Soon
lyrics_original: Soon and very soon, we are going to see the King!
Soon and very soon, we are going to see the King!
Soon and very soon, we are going to see the King!
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, we're going to see the King!
No more crying there, we are going to see the King!
No more crying there, we are going to see the King!
No more crying there, we are going to see the King!
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, we're going to see the King!
No more dying there, we are going to see the King!
No more dying there, we are going to see the King!
No more dying there, we are going to see the King!
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, we're going to see the King!

bible_verses.english: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming quickly.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.
If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the incredible promise that You are preparing a place for us and will one day return. When the hardships of this world feel overwhelming, remind my heart that sorrow and death will not have the final word. Fill me with Your joy and steadfast hope today as I eagerly await the day I will see You face-to-face. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for the incredible promise that You are preparing a place for us and will one day return. devotional.reflection_english: Life often carries deep burdens of sorrow, pain, and loss, but "Soon and Very Soon" lifts our eyes to the ultimate promise of our faith. We are reminded that our present struggles are temporary, and a glorious day is coming when Jesus will wipe away every tear and conquer death forever. As we sing this joyful anthem, we are invited to anchor our hearts in hope and look forward with anticipation to the moment we finally meet our King face-to-face.
